Lecture slides and notes will be linked here as the semester proceeds.

- [Linear Model Prediction Methods](predictionOLS26.qmd) — prediction and quantities of interest in the linear model (at-means and average effects; ML, delta, and simulation-based uncertainty), previewing the methods we generalize to nonlinear models.
- [Binary Response Models](binarymodels26.qmd) — building a maximum-likelihood model for a binary outcome: why the linear probability model fails, the latent-variable and random-utility motivations, the likelihood and link functions, and interpretation via predicted probabilities, marginal effects, and odds.
